title: Spec Dashboard
summary: A local web dashboard, running as its own process, that shows the roadmap, each feature's stage and progress, and the project memory, read from JSON tracking files kept in sync with the Markdown specs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Starts with one command on its own port; the store is not needed.
Overview shows phases (goal, exit criteria), features with status badges, counts per status and the backlog from specs/roadmap.json.
Each feature with a feature.json shows its stage and AC/task progress bars from the JSON.
Feature page shows summary, ACs and tasks with done state, unresolved questions and the rendered spec/plan/tasks.
Memory view shows Current State, the 5 newest progress entries, all decisions and learnings.
Saving a file under specs/ or memory/ updates the open page within 3 seconds.
Missing or invalid tracking files show a message naming the file and problem; the rest still renders.
The dashboard never writes to the repository.
Root npm run check fails when tracking JSON breaks its schema or disagrees with the Markdown, and passes when they agree.
